tha-ap408:1.1: Nanda.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ araññe kānane ahaṃ / pasadamigaṃ gavesanto sayambhum addasam ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:2.1: Anuruddho nāma sambuddho sayambhū aparājito / vivekakāmo so vīro vanamajjh' ogahiṃ tadā // //
tha-ap408:3.1: Catudaṇḍe gahetvāna catuṭṭhāne ṭhapes' ahaṃ / maṇḍapaṃ sukataṃ katvā padumapupphehi chādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap408:4.1: Maṇḍapaṃ chādayitvāna sayambhum abhivādayiṃ / dhanuṃ tatth' eva nikkhippa pabbajim anagāriyaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:5.1: Naciraṃ pabbajitassa vyādhi me udapajjatha / pubbakammaṃ saritvāna tattha kālakato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:6.1: Pubbakammena saṃyutto Tusitam agamās' ahaṃ / tattha sovaṇṇayaṃ vyamhaṃ nibbattati yadicchakaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:7.1: Sahassayuttaṃ hayavāhiṃ dibbaṃ yānam adhiṭṭhito / ārohitvāna taṃ yānaṃ gacchām' ahaṃ yadicchakaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:8.1: Tato me niyyamānassa devabhūtassa me sato / samantā yojanasataṃ maṇḍapo me dhariyyati. // //
tha-ap408:9.1: Sayane so tuvaṭṭhāmi accanta-pupphasanthate / antalikkhā ca padumā vassante niccakālikaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:10.1: Marīcike phandamāne *tappamāne* ca ātape / na maṃ tapati ātapo maṇḍapassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:11.1: Duggatiṃ samatikkanto apāyā pihitā mama / maṇḍape rukkhamūle vā santāpo me na vijjati. // //
tha-ap408:12.1: Mahīsaññam adhiṭṭhāya loṇatoyaṃ tarām' ahaṃ / tassa me sukataṃ kammaṃ Buddhapūjāy idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:13.1: Apatham pi pathaṃ katvāna gacchāmi anilañjase / aho me sukataṃ kammaṃ Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:14.1: Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ / āsavā me parikkhīṇā Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:15.1: Jahitā purimā jāti Buddhassa oraso ahaṃ / dāyādo' mhi ca saddhamme Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:16.1: Ārādhito 'mhi sugataṃ Gotamaṃ Sakyapuṅgavaṃ / dhammaddhajo dhammadāyādo Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:17.1: Upaṭṭhitvāna sambuddhaṃ Gotamaṃ Sakyapuṅgavaṃ / pāraṃ gamaniyaṃ maggam apucchiṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:18.1: Ajjhiṭṭho kathayī Buddho gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ padaṃ / tassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna patto 'mhi āsavakkhayaṃ. // //
tha-ap408:19.1: Aho me sukataṃ kammaṃ parimutto 'mhi jātiyā / sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo n' atthi dāni punabbhavo.
tha-ap408:23.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Nando thero i. g. a-ti.
